columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice number, kept as text; a leading C marks a cancellation invoice; see is_cancellation.
columns.rationale: Fresh profile shows null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2330, unchanged from the committed contract; no change declared for this column.

columns.name: is_cancellation
columns.description: True when invoice_id carries the C cancellation prefix. Cancellations are retained and flagged, not dropped, so conservation arithmetic against bronze stays auditable.
columns.rationale: Fresh profile shows null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2 (false, true), unchanged from the committed contract.

columns.name: stock_code
columns.description: Product code as landed, kept as text; alphanumeric suffixes and non-product adjustment codes (for example POST, M) occur.
columns.rationale: Fresh profile shows null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 3141, unchanged from the committed contract.

columns.name: product_description
columns.description: Product description, whitespace-trimmed; nulls are retained rather than imputed.
columns.rationale: Fresh profile shows null_rate 0.005098 (228 of 44721 rows), consistent with the committed required:false flag; no change declared.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Units on the line. Negative values occur both on cancellation-invoice lines and on zero-unit-price stock-adjustment lines; consumers must not infer cancellation from negative quantity alone.
columns.rationale: Fresh profile shows null_rate 0.0, range -1395 to 5184, unchanged from the committed contract.

columns.name: invoiced_at
columns.description: Invoice timestamp, strict cast from the VARCHAR landing; an unparseable value fails the build loudly rather than becoming a silent null.
columns.rationale: Fresh profile shows null_rate 0.0, unchanged from the committed contract.

columns.name: unit_price
columns.description: Unit price in sterling. Zero-price lines (freebies and adjustments) are retained; negative prices are contract-invalid.
columns.rationale: Fresh profile shows null_rate 0.0, range 0.0 to 1998.49, unchanged from the committed contract.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier. Null values indicate guest or unregistered checkouts and are retained, not dropped or imputed.
columns.rationale: Fresh profile shows null_rate 0.300664 (13446 of 44721 rows), consistent with the committed required:false flag; no change declared.

columns.name: country
columns.rationale: Fresh profile shows null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 24, unchanged from the committed contract.

purpose: The cleaned, typed, one-row-per-invoice-line view of the Online Retail II sample: the first contracted silver table and the sole silver input to the gold unified event star.
usage: Read silver.silver_invoice_lines for line-level retail sales analysis. Cancellation lines are retained and flagged (is_cancellation); consumers aggregating revenue must filter or net them deliberately. Zero-price lines are retained.
limitations: Exact duplicate bronze rows are treated as capture artifacts and excluded, so identical legitimate re-scans are indistinguishable and also excluded; the residual grain is the distinct line. Rows identical in every business column except invoicedate but captured within the same register clock tick collapse to one line with the earliest timestamp retained. customer_id is null for guest or unregistered checkouts and those rows are retained with customer_id null.
